name: Resolving a conflict, then undoing it

steps.text: Open the app's home page and click 'Problems' in the sidebar
Under 'Conflicts' a conflict for 'summary.docx' is listed with the choices 'Keep this computer's version', 'Keep the Drive version' and 'Keep both'
summary.docx is no longer listed under Conflicts and a message offers to undo the choice
The conflict for summary.docx is listed again
